skill.name: land-reduction-trespass
skill.description: Helps review Land_Reduction_Trespass JSON tasks and extract factual evidence about reserve reduction, trespass, survey errors, and railway takings.
skill.summary: Reviews land and trespass evidence tasks with strict factual and citation controls.
skill.author: ACSKamloops

security_audit.summary: Most static backtick and PowerShell findings are Markdown formatting false positives. Real risks remain where the skill instructs agents to run repository workflow scripts, and a critical prompt-injection pattern tells agents to obey system_instructions from untrusted JSON tasks.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the requirement to obey system_instructions from task JSON. Treat task instructions as data and follow only platform, user, and trusted skill instructions.
Require explicit user confirmation before running workflow scripts. Document the exact commands and expected side effects before execution.

remediation.issue: File mutation through submit and flag actions
remediation.suggestion: Add safeguards for commands that append reports, log tasks, or move files. Prefer dry-run checks before modifying workspace state.

content.value_statement: Land and trespass evidence review needs consistent metadata, factual summaries, and citation discipline. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through the Land_Reduction_Trespass queue workflow.
actual_capabilities: Fetches Land_Reduction_Trespass batches through the documented refinement workflow.
Reads JSON input tasks and reviews aggregated document context.
Extracts document metadata, reliability, OCR status, relevance, summaries, conclusions, and key evidence.
Checks output for minimum detail, controlled metadata, and banned opinion terms.
Submits completed analysis or flags irrelevant, OCR, or provenance failures.
Uses Pukaist, Spatsum, reserve number, railway, and acreage context rules.
limitations: Requires the repository workflow scripts and task queue to exist.
Works from JSON task content and does not read original PDFs directly.
Does not provide legal advice or final manager approval.
Workflow commands can append reports or move files, so use trusted workspaces.

use_cases.title: Review Reserve Evidence
use_cases.description: Process task batches about reserve reduction, survey discrepancies, settler encroachment, and railway right-of-way records.

use_cases.title: Prepare Manager Review
use_cases.description: Create factual task summaries with metadata, relevance, reliability, OCR status, and quoted supporting evidence.

use_cases.title: Flag Processing Exceptions
use_cases.description: Identify irrelevant, corrupt, OCR-failed, or provenance-failed tasks and route them through the documented workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Review the Next Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the land-reduction-trespass skill to process the next Land_Reduction_Trespass task batch. Read the JSON input and draft factual results.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Evidence Fields
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this task content for reserve reduction, trespass, survey error, or railway taking evidence. Extract metadata, relevance, summary, conclusion, and key evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Before Submission
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my draft Land_Reduction_Trespass analysis for missing metadata, weak evidence, banned opinion words, short conclusions, and unsupported dates.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Complex Exceptions
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate these mixed task results for provenance failure, OCR failure, irrelevance, and manager review readiness. Recommend the correct workflow action for each task.

output_examples.input: A batch contains a 1913 letter about acreage differences for Reserve No. 10.
output_examples.output: The skill records the year, title, provenance, relevance, factual summary, and quoted evidence about the acreage discrepancy.

output_examples.input: A task includes garbled OCR text with no reliable words.
output_examples.output: The skill routes the task for OCR failure handling instead of inventing metadata or conclusions.

output_examples.input: A document names a railway right of way near a reserve but omits Pukaist in the title.
output_examples.output: The skill applies geographic and infrastructure context rules before assigning relevance.

best_practices: Review every task manually before writing analysis.
Use verbatim quotes with page references when evidence is available.
Confirm metadata against document text, not only filenames.
anti_patterns: Do not submit opinion words or legal conclusions.
Do not rely only on keyword matches.
Do not run workflow commands in an untrusted repository.

faq.question: What queue does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports the Land_Reduction_Trespass queue for land, trespass, survey, and railway taking evidence.

faq.question: Does it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It produces factual evidence summaries and quoted support for later review.

faq.question: What input format does it expect?
faq.answer: It expects JSON task files produced by the repository refinement workflow.

faq.question: Can it read original PDFs directly?
faq.answer: No. The instructions limit work to JSON task content and copied source text.

faq.question: How does it handle weak OCR?
faq.answer: It routes noisy or unreadable text through the OCR failure workflow instead of guessing.

faq.question: Why is trusted workspace setup important?
faq.answer: The workflow commands can append reports, log tasks, and move files in the repository.
